questions.question: Sitara Devi is associated with ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathak dance.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Sitara Devi:-**

 
 
• She was an eminent Indian Kathak dancer.
 
• She is a recipient of Padma Shri, Sangeet Natak Akademi Award, Nritya Nipun, and Kalidas Samman. 
 
• Sitara Devi is a well-known classical Kathak dancer of India, born at the day of the great Indian festival Diwali in Kolkata in 1920.
 
• As she was born on Dipawali, she has also named as Dhanalakshmi (nickname of which is Dhanno). She belongs to the Brahmin family of Varanasi.
 
• Her father, Sukhdev Maharaj, was also a Kathak performer and teacher.
 
• Her mother, Matsya Kumari, belongs to the Royal family of Nepal.
 
• Kathak was the source of income as well as the fervour of her family. Her father had passed all his talent (Kathak, Bharatanatyashastra, Sanskrit) to his children (daughters are Alaknanda, Tara, Dhano and sons are Chaube, Pande). She was depicted as the Nritya Samragini by Rabindranath Tagore when she was just 16.
 
• Rabindranath Tagore encouraged her to revitalize the Indian arts through the Kathak.
 
• Still, She is known as the Kathak queen of India.
 
 
 
• Kathak
 
 
• They were originally a cast of storytellers in north India (Utter Pradesh) who used to sing gestures and songs in temples.
 
• This word is derived from Katha (Sanskrit Word).
 
• This dance was spread in India during the Bhakti Movement in the 16th-17th centuries.
 
• Other Famous Kathak dancers – Birju Maharaj, Lachu Maharaj, Sambu Maharaj, Shovna Narayan.

questions.question: The oxygen molecule is ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Diatomic.**__

__**Explanation:**__

 
• The oxygen molecule is diatomic.
 
• Diatomic molecules are those molecules which are composed of only 2 atoms, of either same or different chemical elements.
 
• Hydrogen (H₂) and oxygen (O₂) are examples of diatomic molecules.

questions.question:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are CORRECT?

I. Acids are sour in taste and generate H+ ions.

II. Acids are sour in taste and generate OH- ions.

III. Bases are bitter in taste and generate OH- ions.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Only I and III.**__

__**Explanation:**__

 ACIDS : 

 
• When these compounds are dissolved in water, they produce hydrogen ions (H⁺ ions).
 
• An acid is classified chemically as a substance that dissolves and donates protons or hydrogen ions to a solution.
 
• Acids have a sour taste for example - lemon juice and vinegar. 
 
• Acids in aqueous solutions are electrolytes, which means they conduct an electrical current. 
 
• The pH range of acids is less than 7. 
 
• Response with indicators -

• Red litmus ramins red​
 
 

BASES: 

 
• Bases, on the other hand, have a bitter taste and are slick to the touch. The term "alkali" refers to a base that can be dissolved in water. Salts are formed when these compounds react chemically with acids. It's common for bases to turn red and litmus blue.
 
• When these compounds are dissolved in water, they produce hydroxide ions (OH⁻ ions).
 
• This means, bases don't have hydrogen ions to dissociate but they have an atom of hydrogen (H) associated with the oxygen to form and hydroxide ion(this OH- dissociateS in water).

questions.question: In India, who among the following is also known as ‘the guardian of the public purse’?

options.text: Comptroller and Auditor General of India

__
 
• **Comptroller and Auditor General of India:-**

 
 
• The Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG) of India is the head of the Indian Audit and Accounts Department. 
 
• CAG controls the entire financial system of the country at both state and central levels and is the supreme body for audits and accounts in India. 
 
• He/ She is appointed by the President of India.
 
• He/ She holds the office for six years or up to the age of 65.
 
• CAG has the same status as the judge of the Supreme court
 
• **It** is also known as ‘the guardian of the public purse’.

 Article 149__

 Article 150__

• **Prime Minister of India:-**

 
 
• The prime minister is appointed by the president of India; however, the prime minister has to enjoy the confidence of the majority of Lok Sabha members, who are directly elected every five years, lest the prime minister shall resign.

__
 
• ** All India Service**

 
 
• All appointments to All India Civil Services are made by the President of India.
 
• The All India Services comprises the Civil Services of India, namely the Indian Administrative Service (IAS), the Indian Police Service (IPS), and the Indian Forest Service (IFS). 
 
• he members of these services are recruited by the Union government, but their services are placed under various State cadres, and they have the liability to serve both under the State and under the Centre.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Tenure of Office:

Safeguards to Civil Servants:

questions.question: Find the resistance (in mega Ω) of a wire of length 8 m, cross sectional area 2 cm² and made of a material of resistivity 120 Ω m.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**4.8.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• CONCEPT__:

 __
 
• Resistance: The property of any conductor that opposes the flow of electric current through it and depends on the shape and size of the materials, temperature, and nature of the materials is called resistance.
 
• It is denoted by R and the SI unit is the ohm (Ω).
 
 

The resistance is given by:

 
• R = ρL/A
 
• where ρ is resistivity, L is the length and A is the area of the cross-section. 

CALCULATION__:

 
• Given that:
 
• Length (L) = 8 m
 
• The cross-sectional area (A) = 2 cm2 = 2 × 10-4 m2
 
• The Resistivity (ρ) = 120 Ω m
 
• We know that,
 
• Resistance (R) = Resistivity (ρ) × (Length(L)/Cross-sectional area (A))
 
• Now,
 
• R = [120 × (8/0.0002)] = 4.8 × 106 Ω = 4.8 × 106 × 10-6 mega Ω 
 
• R = 4.8 mega Ω. So option 2 is correct.

questions.question: Which of the following was not done during the time of Lord Curzon?
